## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the refresh before merge because adding a file can make verification accept hand edits to tracked files.

## Changes

The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register new files, along with tests for adding files and handling existing entries.

## Critical

- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve tracked fingerprints during refresh — Refreshing `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]` after a hand edit to `tracked.txt` makes `verify` accept the edited file. The loop replaces the stored fingerprint with one computed from the edited bytes. — Operators can miss hand edits to tracked files included in a refresh after adding files.

## Important

- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Exclude the manifest from its own entries — Passing `["fingerprints.json"]` with that manifest inside the content root makes verification fail after refresh. Both refresh and registration hash the manifest before rewriting it, so the stored digest describes the previous contents. — A directory-wide file list that includes the manifest leaves operators with an integrity check that fails on otherwise unchanged content. — Fix: Reject paths that refer to the manifest in both helpers before updating it.
